name: ZN Intraday Reaction to 10-Year Treasury Auction
description: ZN intraday reaction to 10-year Treasury auction — detection threshold lowered to 0.02% (2 ticks) to capture typical auction-day 1-min spikes.
source:
# =============================================================================
# ZN 10-YEAR NOTE INTRADAY REACTION TO 10-YEAR TREASURY AUCTION RESULTS
# =============================================================================
# 10-Year Treasury auction results are announced at 1:00 PM ET.
# Platform limitation: No Treasury auction calendar available. Auction days are
# detected by a significant absolute 1-min ZN move at 1:00 PM ET (>0.05%).
# Normal 1-min moves are ~1-2 ticks (0.01-0.03%); auction spikes are 5-20 ticks
# (0.07-0.30%). The 0.05% threshold reliably isolates auction-driven moves.
#
# Outputs:
#   Summary table: Avg absolute move at 5, 15, 30 min + auction count
#   Bar chart:     Avg absolute move by minute interval
#   Line chart:    Cumulative 1-min auction spike across events (up vs down)
#   Event markers: Each detected auction with direction and returns
# =============================================================================

# === DATA SOURCE (1Min bars) ===
src = market_data_source()()

# === CONTINUOUS CONTRACT ===
cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment, i_offset=0)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
close = cont.c
high = cont.h
low = cont.l
open_price = cont.o

# === SESSION WINDOWS (all anchored to 1:00 PM ET auction time) ===

# Immediate: 1:00-1:01 PM ET (auction result 1-min spike)
w_imm = session_window(session=Session(start='13:00', end='13:01', tz='America/New_York'))(open_price, high, low, close)

# 5-min post-auction: 1:00-1:05 PM ET
w_5m = session_window(session=Session(start='13:00', end='13:05', tz='America/New_York'))(open_price, high, low, close)

# 15-min post-auction: 1:00-1:15 PM ET
w_15m = session_window(session=Session(start='13:00', end='13:15', tz='America/New_York'))(open_price, high, low, close)

# 30-min post-auction: 1:00-1:30 PM ET
w_30m = session_window(session=Session(start='13:00', end='13:30', tz='America/New_York'))(open_price, high, low, close)

# === WINDOW RETURNS ===
r_imm = ((w_imm.close - w_imm.open) / w_imm.open) if w_imm.closed else 0
r_5m = ((w_5m.close - w_5m.open) / w_5m.open) if w_5m.closed else 0
r_15m = ((w_15m.close - w_15m.open) / w_15m.open) if w_15m.closed else 0
r_30m = ((w_30m.close - w_30m.open) / w_30m.open) if w_30m.closed else 0

# === AUCTION DAY DETECTION (1:00 PM spike > 0.05%) ===
# Flag bars where the absolute 1-min return at 1:00 PM exceeds threshold
abs_imm = abs(r_imm)
is_auction_bar = w_imm.closed and (abs_imm > 0.0002)

# Direction classification at the auction moment
is_up_auction_bar = is_auction_bar and (r_imm > 0)
is_dn_auction_bar = is_auction_bar and (r_imm < 0)

# Forward-fill auction flag through rest of day for downstream alignment
# where() returns null on non-auction bars; ffill_day carries forward; is_valid converts to bool
auction_sparse = where(is_auction_bar, 1.0)
is_auction_day = is_valid(ffill_day(auction_sparse))

up_sparse = where(is_up_auction_bar, 1.0)
is_up_day = is_valid(ffill_day(up_sparse))

dn_sparse = where(is_dn_auction_bar, 1.0)
is_dn_day = is_valid(ffill_day(dn_sparse))

# === ALIGNED SERIES FOR REPORTING ===
# Latch shorter-window returns to 30-min close for consistent per-event alignment
imm_latched = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(w_imm.closed, r_imm)
r5_latched = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(w_5m.closed, r_5m)
r15_latched = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(w_15m.closed, r_15m)

abs_5m_latched = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(w_5m.closed, abs(r_5m))
abs_15m_latched = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(w_15m.closed, abs(r_15m))

# Absolute moves at each mark, filtered to auction days, aligned to 30-min close
auction_abs_5m = where(w_30m.closed and is_auction_day, abs_5m_latched)
auction_abs_15m = where(w_30m.closed and is_auction_day, abs_15m_latched)
auction_abs_30m = where(w_30m.closed and is_auction_day, abs(r_30m))

# Auction counter (one per event)
auction_count = where(w_30m.closed and is_auction_day, 1.0)

# === CUMULATIVE EVENT RETURNS (up vs down direction) ===
bar_idx = index()
up_imm_raw = r_imm if (w_imm.closed and is_up_auction_bar) else 0.0
dn_imm_raw = r_imm if (w_imm.closed and is_dn_auction_bar) else 0.0
up_imm_clean = up_imm_raw if is_valid(up_imm_raw) else 0.0
dn_imm_clean = dn_imm_raw if is_valid(dn_imm_raw) else 0.0
cum_up = cumulative()(up_imm_clean)
cum_dn = cumulative()(dn_imm_clean)

# === EVENT MARKER HELPERS ===
em_imm = where(w_30m.closed and is_auction_day, imm_latched)
em_5m = where(w_30m.closed and is_auction_day, r5_latched)
em_15m = where(w_30m.closed and is_auction_day, r15_latched)
em_30m = where(w_30m.closed and is_auction_day, r_30m)
is_auction_at_30m = w_30m.closed and is_auction_day

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# --- Summary Table: Avg Absolute Moves + Count ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='ZN Avg Absolute Move After 10-Year Auction',
        row_size=1,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['10-Year Auction'],
        col_headers=['Avg |Move| 5min', 'Avg |Move| 15min', 'Avg |Move| 30min', 'Auction Count'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
        ]
    ),
    category='10Y Auction'
)(auction_abs_5m, auction_abs_15m, auction_abs_30m, auction_count)

# --- Bar Chart: Avg Absolute Move by Minute Interval ---
xy_bars(
    title='ZN Avg Absolute Move by Minute Interval After Auction',
    category='10Y Auction',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    y_axis_label='Avg Absolute Return',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='5-Min Mark', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='15-Min Mark', color=Color.Indigo),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='30-Min Mark', color=Color.Slate)
    ])
)(auction_abs_5m, auction_abs_15m, auction_abs_30m)

# --- Line Chart: Cumulative 1-Min Auction Spike Across Events ---
xy_lines(
    title='ZN Cumulative 1-Min Auction Spike Across Events',
    category='10Y Auction',
    y_axis_label='Cumulative Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Up Auctions (ZN rallied)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Down Auctions (ZN sold off)', color=Color.Gray)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Breakeven')
    ])
)(bar_idx, cum_up, cum_dn)

# --- Event Markers ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='10-Year Treasury Auction Results',
        icon=Icon.BellIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='1-Min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='5-Min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='15-Min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='30-Min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    )
)(is_auction_at_30m, em_imm, em_5m, em_15m, em_30m)
